_source: ColdFusion Short, watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-18: frames at 0/0.5/1/2/5/8/11/14 s then every 8 s to the end, word timings from YouTube's transcript panel (about 200 words a minute). Our own descriptions. 48K views. Cut from a long video.

hook.firstFrame: white title box at the top over conference footage of an audience; a blurred copy fills the frame
hook.firstLine: A tech CEO's clip: competing with us on big models is hopeless.

shots.picture: conference audience footage in a centre band, title box top
a famous AI CEO on stage with a mic, stacked over an interviewer (split band)
silhouette with a briefcase walking away down a bright corridor (stock)
blurred abstract close-up, then archive photo of the founder on a stage
white diagonal-hatch background: a black line icon of a brain-chip labelled AGI, then company logos one at a time
the conference Q&A clip: an investor asks, the CEO answers, audience laughs
a yellow 3D wedge with 'AGI' in black on a dark ground
GPU product close-ups, a trading floor
split frame of headlines and a chip, then a young engineer, then an office of programmers

lines.gist: cold open on a famous CEO saying rivals can't compete on big models
so it was a shock when a fund's co-founder dropped everything for an AI hobby
he pivoted to human-level AI, a goal only giant firms dared
the full clip: asked about a small team, the CEO calls it hopeless
unafraid, he bought thousands of GPUs before export limits hit
he reworked training to need fewer chips and spun off the famous lab

whyItWorks: Cold open on a quote the story then disproves; the payoff answers it.
Simple black line icons on a hatched white ground explain a term (AGI) in one picture.
Each obstacle is met by the founder's move, a chain of setback and answer.
